hypotheses: The explicitly enabled controlled endpoint is producing the observed 5xx burst.
A shared database or Redis failure is causing otherwise normal API routes to return 5xx.
summary: One hundred controlled requests returned 503, raising the five-minute API error ratio above its live anomaly band and firing the dedicated alert.
root_cause: The local DAY4_CHAOS_FORCE_ERROR switch was intentionally enabled for the bounded incident; telemetry did not establish a database, Redis, or external-provider fault.
remediation: Disable controlled error mode, roll out the default config, confirm readiness and a normal fixture chat, then allow the rolling error window to recover.
